Style: polished hand-painted cartoon game interface with carved timber and subtle leafy corner details with parchment title ribbons, bold clear storybook lettering. Palette: deep forest teal, warm parchment and brass gold. Composition: One full-bleed panoramic menu screen, 2:1 aspect ratio, 1280 x 640 export. Frame the edges with restrained themed details. Keep the middle and lower half dark, uncluttered and empty for separate interactive buttons. No drawn buttons, no score labels, no UI placeholders, no characters or scenery. Leave the upper-middle empty for the student to add their own game title. Absolutely no text. No text, logo or watermark.
production.export: Proportional resize to target game dimensions; preserve source alpha for buttons.
